name: Performance / Strength & Conditioning
bestFor: Strength gyms, athletic performance centres, CrossFit-style boxes, premium fitness studios. The most overtly futuristic layout in the library — data, precision and technology are the aesthetic. This is where the depth system runs hardest.

skinOverrides.color.accent: #a3e635 or #22d3ee — an electric cool accent reads more 'performance tech' than red

home.notes: Shader-canvas or pre-rendered forged-geometry loop. Data-overlay treatment on the type. Poster is LCP, video is decoration only.
Glass cards on a dark gradient with grain. The single most 'expensive' section in the library.
Glass cards with hover tilt and rim light.
The methodology. Assessment, programming, measurement — this is what justifies the premium price.
Member transformations, or performance metrics if the gym prefers not to use body imagery.
Rim light and glow on the featured tier only. Restraint is what keeps this from looking tacky.
Depth 0. The conversion surface stays boring and fast — always.

warning: This layout carries the most depth in the library. It is the one most likely to fail the Core Web Vitals gate. Budget check every build: hero poster under 150KB, loop under 500KB, shader under 10KB, and LCP must still land under 2.5s on throttled mobile.
